cases.name: Mayra Gonzalez-Galvan
cases.about: Her obituary said: "Mayra enjoyed dancing, singing, and playing soccer. She was a faithful member of Sacred Heart Catholic Church in Danville, Virginia. Her joyful spirit and love for her family and friends will be deeply missed by all who knew and loved her."
